records.question: Show monthly revenue for this year and the change in rupees compared with the previous month.
records.generated_sql:
WITH monthly_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month,
        ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS revenue
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'completed'
      AND order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of year', '-1 month')
      AND order_date < date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '+1 month')
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_date)
),
rev_with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue
    FROM monthly_rev
)
SELECT 
    month,
    revenue,
    ROUND(revenue - prev_revenue, 2) AS change_in_rupees
FROM rev_with_lag
WHERE month >= strftime('%Y-%m', date('2026-11-07', 'start of year'))
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 500;

records.question: Which customers placed at least one order in each of the last 3 full calendar months?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name, c.city, c.country
FROM customers AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o1 
    WHERE o1.customer_id = c.id 
      AND o1.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-3 months')
      AND o1.order_date < date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-2 months')
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o2 
    WHERE o2.customer_id = c.id 
      AND o2.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-2 months')
      AND o2.order_date < date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-1 month')
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o3 
    WHERE o3.customer_id = c.id 
      AND o3.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-1 month')
      AND o3.order_date < date('2026-11-07', 'start of month')
)
ORDER BY c.name
LIMIT 500;

records.question: What share of this year's revenue comes from each product category, as a percentage rounded to one decimal?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT p.category AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) FROM order_items AS oi2 JOIN orders AS o2 ON o2.id = oi2.order_id WHERE o2.status = 'completed' AND o2.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of year')), 1) AS revenue_share_percentage
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of year')
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue_share_percentage DESC
LIMIT 500;
